summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (no code changes made — investigation only)  **What I already checked (read-only, no edits):** I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → SQLite. On paper it's wired correctly: - The API client sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so the session cookie always goes out. - `watchlistRouter.use("*", ...)` requires a valid `arca_session` cookie on every watchlist route and scopes every query by `user_id`. - `login()` in `db/auth.ts` always returns the same permanent account `id` from the `users`
